parameters.content:
Core AI Brain — billing via platform API (v7)

ONE-TIME SETUP (n8n UI, no server access needed):
  Credentials → New → "Header Auth"
    Name  : x-n8n-secret
    Value : (Vercel project "driplare-ai"-এর N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET মান)
  তারপর "Billing API" নোডের Credential ড্রপডাউনে
  credential-টা select করুন — খালি রাখলে নোড চলবে না।

  ⚠️ এটা না করলে "Billing API" 401 পাবে আর প্রতিটি
  reply-তে credit কাটা চুপচাপ বন্ধ থাকবে — reply ঠিকই
  আসবে, তাই ভুল ধরা পড়বে না। ইমপোর্টের পর একটা টেস্ট
  মেসেজ দিয়ে ব্যালেন্স সত্যিই কমছে কি না দেখে নিন।

CHAIN: ... → Save Chat History → Billing API → Return to Platform
Billing API → POST https://driplare-ai.vercel.app/api/internal/ai-usage
  (এটাই প্ল্যাটফর্ম অ্যাপের ডোমেইন। www.driplare.com-এ
   অ্যাপটি নেই — ওখানে সব /api রুট ৪০৪ দেয়।)

This node is the ONLY place credits are deducted now. It also
writes the AIUsageLog. runId = $execution.id makes retries
idempotent — the same run can never be charged twice.

Cost is NOT computed here. Prices come from live OpenRouter
data on the platform side, so there is nothing to keep in sync.

parameters.query:
WITH knowledge AS (
  SELECT content, false AS "isQuotedContext"
  FROM "chatbot"."Chunk"
  WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL AND ("chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}' OR metadata->>'chatbotId' = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}')
  ORDER BY embedding <=> '[{{ $json.embedding.values.join(',') }}]'::vector
  LIMIT 5
), quoted AS (
  SELECT "content", true AS "isQuotedContext"
  FROM "chatbot"."ChatMessage"
  WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
    AND "sessionId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}'
    AND "platformMessageId" = '{{ String($('When Called by Platform').item.json.replyToMessageId || '').replace(/'/g, String.fromCharCode(39,39)) }}'
    AND '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.replyToMessageId || '' }}' <> ''
  ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT content, "isQuotedContext" FROM knowledge
UNION ALL
SELECT content, "isQuotedContext" FROM quoted;

options.systemMessage:
={{ $('Fetch Bot Config').item.json.systemPrompt + "

=== KNOWLEDGE BASE CONTEXT ===
Use ONLY the retrieved context below to answer general questions (FAQs, policies, delivery, company info). If the answer is not here and it is not a product or order task, tell the customer you will connect them with a human agent.

" + ($json.knowledgeContext || "(no relevant knowledge found)") + "

=== LANGUAGE RULES ===
1. Detect the customer language (English, Bangla, or Banglish) and ALWAYS reply in that same language and script.
2. Never refuse to speak Bangla. Keep product names, sizes and IDs in their original script.

=== TONE & FORMATTING ===
1. Be friendly, natural and human. Greet only in the first message of a conversation.
2. Use clean spacing, bullet points and relevant emojis.
3. When you show a product image, put the image URL on its OWN line prefixed with '[IMG] '. These lines are turned into an image gallery and removed from the visible reply text.

=== TOOLS ===
1. 'Product Lookup' - call FIRST for ANY product question (name, price, stock, size, colour, material, availability). Never guess product data.
2. 'Create Order' - call ONLY after the customer has confirmed items, quantity, name, phone and full delivery address. Never invent missing details; ask for them first.

=== PRODUCT CARDS ===
Use [CARDS] only when the customer wants to browse the catalogue: 'what do you sell', 'show me your products', 'কী কী আছে', 'প্রোডাক্ট দেখাও', ছবি, ফটো, image, photo or picture.
1. Call 'Product Lookup' first.
2. For a browse or list request, write at most ONE short friendly line (for example: 'আমাদের কিছু প্রোডাক্ট দেখুন 👇' or 'Here are some of our products 👇'), then add ONE line at the very end of your reply in this exact form:
[CARDS] productId1,productId2
3. NEVER list product names, prices, stock or descriptions in that visible line. The cards already show each product - do not repeat them in text.
4. When the customer asks about ONE specific product, answer with a short description and price and do NOT use [CARDS]. For its photos, use only image URLs returned by Product Lookup and put each requested image on its own [IMG] line. For a follow-up such as 'show more photos' with no product name, use the latest product discussed in this conversation; never switch to unrelated products. For that product, call Product Lookup and send only its image URLs using [IMG] lines; never use product cards.
5. Use ONLY productId values returned by Product Lookup in this turn, and only products that actually have an imageUrl or imageUrls value. If the customer named a specific product, include only that product. For a browse request, include at most 5 products. If you cannot name usable ids for a broad catalogue browse request, write [CARDS] alone with no ids - the platform will send the catalogue. For a specific product or a follow-up about its photos, never use a bare [CARDS].
6. Maximum 10 ids. Do NOT add [IMG] lines for products you put in [CARDS].
7. The [CARDS] line is removed before the customer sees it - never mention it.
8. Keep the visible text short and friendly.

=== ORDER CARD TAPS ===
When the customer message starts with [ORDER_CARD:<productId>], they tapped the Order button on that product card.
1. Call 'Product Lookup' with that productId and use the returned name and price.
2. Reply with ONE short line naming the product, then collect the order details ONE question at a time, in this order: quantity -> full name -> phone number -> full delivery address (area, thana and district).
3. Never ask several questions in one message and never invent a detail the customer did not give.
4. When every detail is known, call 'Create Order' with items_json containing productId, name, qty and price, plus customer_name, customer_phone, delivery_address, district, delivery_fee, and total_amount (the confirmed grand total). Use only a delivery fee from verified business rules or the amount already quoted and confirmed; never guess it. If no verified fee is available, ask instead of creating the order.
5. After 'Create Order' succeeds, confirm the order number and total. The Facebook Messenger integration sends the native receipt card; never invent receipt details or include receipt image URLs.
6. Never show the [ORDER_CARD:...] text to the customer." }}

parameters.toolDescription: Look up LIVE product catalogue info (name, price, stock, colours, sizes, description, images) for this store. ALWAYS call before answering any product question.
parameters.query: SELECT "productId","name","description","price","currency","stock","variants","imageUrl","imageUrls" FROM "ecommerce"."Product" WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}' AND "isActive" = true AND ("name" ILIKE '%' || '{{ String($fromAI('product_name', 'the product name, keyword or productId the customer asked about', 'string') || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' || '%' OR "description" ILIKE '%' || '{{ String($fromAI('product_name', 'the product name, keyword or productId the customer asked about', 'string') || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' || '%' OR "productId" = '{{ String($fromAI('product_name', 'the product name, keyword or productId the customer asked about', 'string') || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') LIMIT 10;

parameters.toolDescription: Create a confirmed customer order. Call ONLY after the customer confirms the items, quantity, customer name, phone, full delivery address, delivery fee, and grand total. delivery_fee must come from verified business delivery rules or the amount already quoted and confirmed in this conversation; never guess it. total_amount must equal the product subtotal plus delivery_fee. The response tells you whether the order was created; if it was not, read the reason and ask the customer for what is missing or needs reconfirmation.

parameters.query:
WITH catalog AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    position(lower(p."name") in lower('{{ $('Format Response').item.json.userMessageSql }}')) > 0 AS named_in_message,
    (SELECT max(m."timestamp")
     FROM "chatbot"."ChatMessage" m
     WHERE m."chatbotId" = p."chatbotId"
       AND m."sessionId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}'
       AND m."role" = 'assistant'
       AND m."timestamp" > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
       AND position(lower(p."name") in lower(m."content")) > 0) AS last_discussed_at
  FROM "ecommerce"."Product" p
  WHERE p."chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
    AND p."isActive" = true
), context_product AS (
  SELECT c."productId"
  FROM catalog c
  JOIN "chatbot"."ChatMessage" m
    ON m."chatbotId" = c."chatbotId"
   AND m."sessionId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}'
   AND m."role" = 'assistant'
   AND m."timestamp" = c.last_discussed_at
  WHERE c.last_discussed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY m."timestamp" DESC, position(lower(c."name") in lower(m."content")) ASC
  LIMIT 1
), selected_products AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM catalog c
  WHERE c.named_in_message
     OR (
       '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.asksForImagesSql }}' = '1'
       AND '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.isBroadBrowseSql }}' = '0'
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog explicit WHERE explicit.named_in_message)
       AND c."productId" IN (SELECT contextual."productId" FROM context_product contextual)
     )
), card_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower("name"))
    "productId", "name", "price", "currency",
    COALESCE(NULLIF("imageUrls"[1], ''), NULLIF("imageUrl", '')) AS "imageUrl",
    "postUrl",
    array_position(string_to_array('{{ $('Format Response').item.json.carouselIdsSql }}', ','), "productId") AS "position"
  FROM catalog
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF("imageUrls"[1], ''), NULLIF("imageUrl", '')) ~* '^https?://'
    AND (
      ((('{{ $('Format Response').item.json.wantsCardsSql }}' = '1' OR '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.carouselIdsSql }}' <> '') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_products) AND "productId" IN (SELECT "productId" FROM selected_products))
      OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_products)
          AND "productId" = ANY(string_to_array('{{ $('Format Response').item.json.carouselIdsSql }}', ',')))
      OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_products)
          AND '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.carouselIdsSql }}' = ''
          AND '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.wantsCardsSql }}' = '1'
          AND ('{{ $('Format Response').item.json.isBroadBrowseSql }}' = '1' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog contextual WHERE contextual.last_discussed_at IS NOT NULL)))
    )
  ORDER BY lower("name"),
    (COALESCE(NULLIF("imageUrls"[1], ''), NULLIF("imageUrl", '')) ~* '^https://') DESC,
    "price" NULLS LAST, "productId"
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'productId', card."productId", 'name', card."name', 'price', card."price',
    'currency', card."currency', 'imageUrl', card."imageUrl', 'postUrl', card."postUrl'
  ) ORDER BY card."position" NULLS LAST, card."name") FROM card_rows card), '[]'::json) AS "cards",
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(gallery.image_url ORDER BY gallery.product_rank, gallery.image_rank)
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (p."productId", images.image_url)
        p."productId", images.image_url,
        CASE WHEN p.named_in_message THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS product_rank,
        images.image_rank
      FROM selected_products p
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(COALESCE(p."imageUrls", ARRAY[]::text[]) || ARRAY[COALESCE(p."imageUrl", '')]) WITH ORDINALITY AS images(image_url, image_rank)
      WHERE '{{ $('Format Response').item.json.asksForImagesSql }}' = '1'
        AND images.image_url ~* '^https?://'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM "chatbot"."ChatMessage" sent
          WHERE sent."chatbotId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}'
            AND sent."sessionId" = '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.sessionId }}'
            AND sent."mediaType" = 'image'
            AND sent."mediaUrl" = images.image_url
        )
      ORDER BY p."productId", images.image_url, images.image_rank
      LIMIT 5
    ) gallery
  ), '[]'::json) AS "productImages";

String.fromCharCode(39) + 'carousel' + String.fromCharCode(39) : 'NULL' }}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NOW());

INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatMessage" ("id","chatbotId","userId","sessionId","role","content","mediaUrl","mediaType","timestamp")
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  '{{ $('When Called by Platform').item.json.chatbotId }}',

  'assistant',
  '[Image]',

  'image',

FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
  '{{ JSON.stringify([...new Set([...(Array.isArray($('Format Response').item.json.galleryImages) ? $('Format Response').item.json.galleryImages : []), ...(Array.isArray($('Fetch Product Cards').item.json.productImages) ? $('Fetch Product Cards').item.json.productImages : [])])]).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb
) WITH ORDINALITY AS images(image_url, image_rank)
WHERE image_url ~* '^https?://';

parameters.content:
═══ AUTOMATION GATE — অবস্থা ও চেকলিস্ট ═══

সম্পূর্ণ গাইড (troubleshooting সহ):
  docs/n8n-JSON/Automation-Gate-Setup.md

এই ফাইলে কানেকশন আগেই বসানো আছে:
  Ensure Session → Automation Gate → Gate Decision → Gate Reply?
  Gate Reply? (true)     → Gate Return
  Gate Reply? (false)    → Quota Allowed?
  Quota Allowed? (true)  → Media Router
  Quota Allowed? (false) → Quota Blocked Reply

⚠️ TASK-11: `Quota Check` নোডটি বাদ দেওয়া হয়েছে।
  credit জিজ্ঞেস করাটা এখন Automation Gate-এর
  নিজের উত্তরের ভেতরেই আসে (`quota` field), তাই
  একটা পুরো আন্তঃমহাদেশীয় হপ বাঁচে।
  Quota Allowed? এখন `$json.quota?.allowed`
  দেখে — অর্থাৎ আগের `$json.allowed` নয়।
আর Format Response-এ gateText prepend করার কোডও আছে।
তাই হাতে আর কিছু জোড়ার দরকার নেই।

এখন শুধু দুটো কাজ বাকি:

১) Credentials → New → "Header Auth"
     Name  : x-driplare-internal
     Value : (Vercel project "driplare-ai"-এর
              AUTOMATION_INTERNAL_SECRET মান)
   তারপর "Automation Gate" নোডের Credential
   ড্রপডাউনে credential-টা select করুন —
   খালি রাখলে 401 আসবে।

২) ⚠️ আগে অন্তত একটা সক্রিয় Rule বানান!
   Rule না থাকলে ইঞ্জিন কোনো run row লেখেই না,
   তাই Activity Log খালি থাকবে — অথচ Gate ঠিকই
   ডাকছিল।
   (/dashboard/automations → Create Rule → Active)

nodes.name: Quota Allowed?
nodes.notes:
true = run the AI. false = the platform explicitly refused. An unreadable answer counts as true — fail open, never mute a live conversation on a transient error.

The verdict rides in on `Automation Gate`'s response (`quota`), not on a node of its own: TASK-11 folded the quota pre-flight into the Gate so one intercontinental hop disappeared. `$json.quota` is undefined only on a version skew — an older Gate — and `undefined !== false` is true, which is the same fail-open rule as before.

nodes.name: Quota Blocked Reply
nodes.notes: Terminal node. No model ran, so nothing is billed and nothing is written to chat history.

nodes.name: AI Failed Reply
nodes.notes: Wired to the AI Agent's error output. Turns a hard failure into a sentence instead of silence.

parameters.content:
═══ QUOTA GUARD — কেন, কীভাবে, কী পরীক্ষা করবেন ═══

CHAIN: Gate Reply? (false) → Quota Allowed? → Media Router
       Quota Allowed? (false) → Quota Blocked Reply  [শেষ]

● TASK-11: আলাদা `Quota Check` নোডটি আর নেই
  verdict আসে `Automation Gate`-এর নিজের উত্তরেই, `quota` field-এ।
  n8n বাংলাদেশে, প্ল্যাটফর্ম Vercel-এ, ডাটাবেস Singapore-এ — তাই প্রতিটি বাড়তি
  node মানে দুই দিকের আন্তঃমহাদেশীয় যাতায়াত। প্রশ্নটা এখনো আলাদা প্রশ্নই,
  শুধু এখন একই অনুরোধে একসাথে জিজ্ঞেস করা হয় — আর রেড-দুটো Gate-এর আটটির
  নিচে লুকিয়ে যায়, তাই latency বাড়ে না।
  `Quota Allowed?` পড়ে `$json.quota?.allowed` — পুরনো `$json.allowed` নয়।

● কেন এখানে, Gate-এর পরে?
  Gate-এর ক্যানড উত্তর (canned reply) প্ল্যাটফর্মের কাছে বিনামূল্যে — credit
  না থাকলেও সেটি পাঠানো উচিত। তাই ভ্রমণটা Gate-এর পরে, ঠিক যেখানে টাকা খরচ
  শুরু হয় সেখানে।
  ⚠️ আগে এখানে লেখা ছিল "Gate-এর সাথে জুড়বেন না, কারণ TASK-11 গেটটিকে cache
     করবে"। সেটি ভুল প্রমাণিত: runEvent কেবল পড়ে না — ChatMessage ও
     AutomationRun লেখে, side effect চালায়, আর frequency cap আগের run-এর উপর
     নির্ভর করে। তাই উত্তর cache করা যায় না। যা করা হয়েছে তা ভিন্ন কিছু:
     কলটা সরানো হয়নি, একত্রে করা হয়েছে।

● Credential
  এই যাচাইয়ের নিজের আলাদা কিছু লাগে না — উত্তরটা বয়ে আনে `Automation Gate`,
  যার credential দেয় x-driplare-internal = AUTOMATION_INTERNAL_SECRET।
  (`/api/internal/ai-quota` রুটটি এখনো আছে — ফেরার পথ হিসেবে। সেটি ব্যবহার
  করলে credential "Driplare Platform Secret": x-n8n-secret = N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET।)
  ⚠️ দুটো আলাদা secret — গুলিয়ে ফেললে 401।

● fail-open — ইচ্ছে করেই
  কেবল `allowed: false` পেলেই আটকায়। প্ল্যাটফর্ম ডাউন / timeout / 404 হলে
  AI চলে — একটি ক্ষণিকের সার্ভার ত্রুটি যেন চলতি গ্রাহক-কথোপকথন চুপ না করে।
  `quota` field না এলেও (`undefined !== false`) AI চলবে — অর্থাৎ পুরনো
  `Automation Gate` নোডের সাথেও এই chain কাজ করে। নিয়মিত চেক করুন:
  n8n → Executions → Automation Gate নোডে 200, উত্তরে `quota` এসেছে কি না।
  ⚠️ প্ল্যাটফর্মের দিকেও একই নিয়ম মানা হয়, তবে verdict-টা আলাদা করে ধরা হয় —
     রুটের fail-open catch কেবল **ইঞ্জিনের** উত্তরের জন্য। নইলে credit শেষ
     হওয়া merchant-এর AI চুপচাপ চলতেই থাকত।

● Model fallback এখানে নেই কেন
  OpenRouter-এর আসল fallback হলো request body-র `models: [...]` তালিকা।
  n8n-এর "OpenRouter Chat Model" node-এ ওই field নেই (শুধু একটা Model
  dropdown + temperature/maxTokens/timeout/maxRetries) — তাই LangChain
  Agent-এর ভেতর দিয়ে cross-model fallback পাঠানো সম্ভব নয়।
  যা করা হয়েছে: node-এ timeout ৬০ সেকেন্ড (আগে ৬ মিনিট ছিল), maxRetries 2,
  আর ব্যর্থ হলে AI Failed Reply — অর্থাৎ নিরবতা নয়, একটা বোধগম্য বার্তা।

● পরীক্ষা
  ১) Playground/Web থেকে একটা সাধারণ মেসেজ — উত্তর আসা উচিত।
  ২) Executions খুলে দেখুন Automation Gate → 200, উত্তরে quota.allowed: true।
  ৩) কোনো টেস্ট merchant-এর creditsBalance 0 করে দিন, তারপর মেসেজ দিন —
     AI Agent একেবারেই চলবে না (credit খরচ ০), আর গ্রাহক পাবেন
     "দুঃখিত, এই মুহূর্তে উত্তর দিতে পারছি না..." — merchant পাবেন মেইল।
